title: Cache bypass and retention policy for the development loop
question_or_target: Provide an explicit --no-cache bypass and a bounded retention policy (max entries, max bytes, LRU eviction) wired into the existing plugin-cache-reaper scheduled task, so an unbounded cache cannot become the disk-pressure source that freezes this box.

evidence.claim: With --no-cache the instrumentation recompute counter increments and content is recomputed, while an out-of-band os.walk+stat directory census (names, sizes, mtimes) is unchanged — two independent signals. The counter alone could be miswired.

Exceeding the byte ceiling evicts LRU entries and the newest entry survives. Retention floor keeps the N newest even when still over the byte budget. The PluginCacheReaper scheduled task is updated in place (Set-ScheduledTask) rather than replaced.
